title: Joe W NDE 16063
content: THE GOLDEN LIGHT I REMEMBER A TIME FROM LONG AGO ABOUT A MOTHER AND HER SON HOW TRAGEDY HAD FALLEN AND HIS LIFE HAD JUST BEGUN THIS IS A SPECIAL STORY AND I HOPE I TELL IT RIGHT THE MIGHTY BOND OF A MOTHERS LOVE AND THE COURAGE SHE HAD TO FIGHT YOU SEE HER SON HAD TAKEN ILL AND THE DOCTOR TRIED IN VAIN NO MEDICATION SEEMED TO WORK AND THE MOTHERS FACE SHOWED PAIN EXHAUSTED FROM THE CARE SHE'D GAVE SHE FELL INTO DEEP SLEEP HER LITTLE BOY TUCKED IN HER ARMS SHE PRAYED HIS SOUL TO KEEP HIS FEVER RAGED ON THROUGH THE NIGHT AND HE DIDN'T EVEN CRY SHE AWOKE TO SILENCE IN THE ROOM "MY GOD HE'S GOING TO DIE". SHE WRAPPED HIM IN SOME BLANKETS AND HURRIED INTO TOWN THE DOCTOR TOOK HIM IN HIS ARMS AND ASKED HER TO SIT DOWN WITH A MINDFUL EYE HE CHECKED HER SON AND HE SAID WITH A SOMBER FACE HE'S IN A DEEP DEEP COMA TAKE HIM HOME AND WAIT I'LL COME AND SEE TOMORROW IF ANY CHANGE HAS TAKEN PLACE KEEP HIM WARM AND PRAY FOR HIM HE NEEDS....."AMAZING GRACE" THE TEARS WERE FALLING FROM HER CHIN AS SHE CARRIED HER SON HOME WHERE ARE YOU GOD? I NEED YOU NOW WHY MUST I STAND ALONE? THE NIGHT WAS LONG AND NEIGHBORS CAME TO WATCH WITH HER AND WAIT AND GIVE SUPPORT THE BEST THEY COULD AND PONDER HER CHILD'S FATE IT SEEMED AS IF FOREVER BEFORE THE DOCTOR CAME HE LOOKED INTO THE INFANTS EYES AND SAID THERE'D BEEN NO CHANGE THE TEARS FLOWED DOWN THE MOTHERS FACE HER FEARS WERE COMING TRUE SHE DIDN'T WANT TO LISTEN BUT THE WORDS KEPT COMING THROUGH SHE COULD HEAR THE DOCTOR TELLING HER AS SHE WAS TRYING NOT TO CRY YOU'VE GOT ANOTHER DAY OR SO BUT I THINK HE'S GOING TO DIE IF THINGS DON'T CHANGE BY MORNING LIGHT I'LL MAKE THE FUNERAL CALL AND HAVE THEM MAKE A SMALL PINE BOX AND PLACE IT IN THE HALL IN FRANTIC DESPERATION THE MOTHERS MIND RAN WILD WHAT CAN I DO? WHAT CAN I DO? TO SAVE MY LITTLE CHILD. WITH DISTANT EYES, FULL OF TEARS SOMETHING SPOKE FROM DEEP WITHIN TAKE YOUR SON UP IN THE HILLS TO "NONA" THE INDIAN AS SHE APPROACHED THE MAKESHIFT DOOR "NONA" SWUNG IT WIDE TAKE THE CHILD TO THE TABLE THERE SHE POINTED AND STEPPED ASIDE NOW THE BOY LAY UNCONSCIOUS BUT THERE'S A LIGHT THAT HE CAN SEE A GOLDEN LIGHT, "ITS BEAUTIFUL"! ITS......... LIKE, ETERNITY IT SURROUNDED HIM WITH AWESOME LOVE AND CARRIED HIM UP HIGH MAGNIFICENCE HAD SURROUNDED HIM HE WAS NOT AFRAID TO DIE HE LOOKED DOWN AT THE TABLE AND SAW THE WOMEN WORKING THERE THEY WERE PUTTING OIL ALL OVER HIM BUT HE DIDN'T REALLY CARE THEY WRAPPED HIM IN A HEAVY CLOTH TO KEEP HIS BODY WARM THE LIGHT OF LOVE SAID "GO BACK NOW" WHEN ITS TIME I'LL CALL YOU HOME HE DIDN'T WANT TO LEAVE THAT LIGHT BUT THE CHOICE WAS MORE DIVINE THE LIGHT SAID I WILL FOLLOW YOU AND WILL NEVER LEAVE YOUR MIND A MOTHERS PRAYER WAS ANSWERED THAT NIGHT SHE GOT HER SON A GIFT THAT GOD GAVE BACK TO HER A BATTLE THAT SHE'D WON AS FOR THE BOY THAT GOD SENT BACK HE GREW TO LOVE THE LIGHT I KNOW .....................I WAS THAT BOY AND THE LIGHT WAS "JESUS CHRIST"

arrival.religious_figure_detail: The experiencer identifies the light as “JESUS CHRIST.”

environment.environment_other_detail: A “golden light” described as “beautiful… like, eternity,” surrounding him with “awesome love” and carrying him “up high.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Infant with severe fever and “deep deep coma.”

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He observes women applying oil to his body while he is in the light.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience centers on seeing/being in a golden light, observing the body being treated, being told to go back, then returning; no tunnel or life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Narrative is presented as a story/poem about an infant; includes an earthly scene of being taken to “NONA” (an Indian healer) and observing women putting oil on him while he is in the light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “A GOLDEN LIGHT, ‘ITS BEAUTIFUL’! ITS......... LIKE, ETERNITY” / “MAGNIFICENCE HAD SURROUNDED HIM HE WAS NOT AFRAID TO DIE” / “The light of love said ‘GO BACK NOW’ … ‘WHEN ITS TIME I’LL CALL YOU HOME’” / “THE LIGHT WAS ‘JESUS CHRIST’”
